newsitem.title: RUSSIA: FORECAST-Russian '97 annual inflation seen 11 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Russian '97 annual inflation seen 11 pct.

text.p: Russian annual inflation is likely to be around 11 percent this year, in line with an Economy Ministry forecast, a senior State Statistics Committee official said on Monday.
"By our estimates, taken that August usually sees deflation, we think the inflation rate will coincide with the Economy Ministry's forecasts," Deputy Chairman Vladimir Sokolin told a news conference.
Russian consumer prices have risen 7.8 percent so far this year.
Sokolin said June inflation was likely to be slightly higher than in April and nudge up to one or 1.1 percent from 0.9 percent.
Deflation in August usually occurs on seasonal factors connected to lower agricultural prices. June prices are usually higher on the eve of the harvest.
